description: ZFS pool, dataset, PVC and snapshot capacity from zfs_exporter. ARC and I/O detail lives in Node - ZFS Stats.

panels.title: Pool health
panels.description: zpool state reported by zfs_exporter. 0 = ONLINE (healthy).

panels.title: Capacity used

targets.expr: max by (pool) (zfs_pool_allocated_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool"}) / max by (pool) (zfs_pool_size_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool"})

panels.description: Allocated / size. ZFS performance degrades as pools fill; keep under ~80%.

panels.title: Snapshot age (newest)
panels.description: Time since the most recent snapshot. Sanoid takes hourly snapshots, so >2h means it has stalled.

panels.title: Pool details

targets.expr: max by (pool) (zfs_pool_allocated_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool"}) / max by (pool) (zfs_pool_size_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool"})

max by (pool) (zfs_dataset_logical_used_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", type="filesystem", name!~".*/.*"}) / max by (pool) (zfs_dataset_used_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", type="filesystem", name!~".*/.*"})

panels.description: Compression is logical ÷ physical used for the pool's root dataset. On raidz with small volblocksize zvols it can read below 1.0 because parity/padding overhead outweighs compression.

targets.expr: max by (pool) (zfs_pool_allocated_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool"}) / max by (pool) (zfs_pool_size_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool"})

panels.title: Free space & projected fill
panels.description: Dashed series extrapolate the free-space trend over the selected range 30 days ahead. Use a range of a week or more for a meaningful projection.

panels.title: Fragmentation
panels.description: Free-space fragmentation. High values slow writes as the pool fills.

panels.title: Filesystems

targets.expr: max by (name, pool) (zfs_dataset_logical_used_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", type="filesystem"}) / (max by (name, pool) (zfs_dataset_used_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", type="filesystem"}) > 0)

panels.description: Used includes children and snapshots; Used by dataset is what destroying only this dataset would free. Quota 0 = none.

panels.title: Largest growth over range (top 15)

targets.expr:
topk(15, (
  label_join(
    label_replace((max by (name) (delta(zfs_dataset_used_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", type!="snapshot"}[$__range]))
    unless on (name) label_replace(max by (parent) (label_replace(zfs_dataset_used_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", type!="snapshot"}, "parent", "$1", "name", "(.*)/[^/]+")), "name", "$1", "parent", "(.*)")), "persistentvolume", "$1", "name", ".*/(pvc-[0-9a-f-]+)$")
    * on (persistentvolume) group_left (claim_namespace, claim) max by (persistentvolume, claim_namespace, claim) (label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_claim_ref, "claim", "$1", "name", "(.*)")),
    "display", "/", "claim_namespace", "claim")
  or on (name) label_replace((max by (name) (delta(zfs_dataset_used_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", type!="snapshot"}[$__range]))
    unless on (name) label_replace(max by (parent) (label_replace(zfs_dataset_used_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", type!="snapshot"}, "parent", "$1", "name", "(.*)/[^/]+")), "name", "$1", "parent", "(.*)")), "display", "$1", "name", "(.*)")
) > 0)

panels.description: Change in used bytes (including snapshots) of leaf datasets across the selected time range. PVC datasets are labelled namespace/claim; others by dataset name.

panels.title: Write rate by dataset (top 10)
panels.description: From node_exporter on the same host. Leaf datasets only; zvols are not included.

  max by (persistentvolume, claim_namespace, claim) (label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_claim_ref, "claim", "$1", "name", "(.*)"))

max by (name, pool, persistentvolume) (label_replace(zfs_dataset_logical_used_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", name=~".*/pvc-[0-9a-f-]+", type="volume"}, "persistentvolume", "$1", "name", ".*/(pvc-[0-9a-f-]+)$"))
  * on (persistentvolume) group_left (claim_namespace, claim)
  max by (persistentvolume, claim_namespace, claim) (label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_claim_ref, "claim", "$1", "name", "(.*)"))
/ on (name, pool, persistentvolume) group_left
max by (name, pool, persistentvolume) (label_replace(zfs_dataset_volume_size_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool"}, "persistentvolume", "$1", "name", ".*/(pvc-[0-9a-f-]+)$"))

max by (name, pool, persistentvolume) (label_replace(zfs_dataset_used_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", name=~".*/pvc-[0-9a-f-]+", type!="snapshot"}, "persistentvolume", "$1", "name", ".*/(pvc-[0-9a-f-]+)$"))
  * on (persistentvolume) group_left (claim_namespace, claim)
  max by (persistentvolume, claim_namespace, claim) (label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_claim_ref, "claim", "$1", "name", "(.*)"))

max by (name, pool, persistentvolume) (label_replace(zfs_dataset_written_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", name=~".*/pvc-[0-9a-f-]+", type!="snapshot"}, "persistentvolume", "$1", "name", ".*/(pvc-[0-9a-f-]+)$"))
  * on (persistentvolume) group_left (claim_namespace, claim)
  max by (persistentvolume, claim_namespace, claim) (label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_claim_ref, "claim", "$1", "name", "(.*)"))

(max by (name, pool, persistentvolume) (label_replace(zfs_dataset_referenced_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", name=~".*/pvc-[0-9a-f-]+", type!="snapshot"}, "persistentvolume", "$1", "name", ".*/(pvc-[0-9a-f-]+)$"))
  * on (persistentvolume) group_left (claim_namespace, claim)
  max by (persistentvolume, claim_namespace, claim) (label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_claim_ref, "claim", "$1", "name", "(.*)"))) * 0
+ on (claim_namespace, claim) group_left ()
(max by (claim_namespace, claim) (label_replace(label_replace(kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes, "claim_namespace", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "claim", "$1", "persistentvolumeclaim", "(.*)")) / max by (claim_namespace, claim) (label_replace(label_replace(kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes, "claim_namespace", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "claim", "$1", "persistentvolumeclaim", "(.*)")))

clamp_min(
max by (name, pool, persistentvolume) (label_replace(zfs_dataset_logical_used_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", name=~".*/pvc-[0-9a-f-]+", type="volume"}, "persistentvolume", "$1", "name", ".*/(pvc-[0-9a-f-]+)$"))
  * on (persistentvolume) group_left (claim_namespace, claim)
  max by (persistentvolume, claim_namespace, claim) (label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_claim_ref, "claim", "$1", "name", "(.*)"))
- on (claim_namespace, claim) group_left
max by (claim_namespace, claim) (label_replace(label_replace(kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes, "claim_namespace", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "claim", "$1", "persistentvolumeclaim", "(.*)")), 0)

panels.description:
zvols / filesystems created by democratic-csi, joined to their PVC via kube-state-metrics.

FS used: what the filesystem inside the volume reports (kubelet) — this is the real fullness.
ZFS allocated: logical blocks ever written to the zvol ÷ size. Without TRIM/discard, blocks freed by deleting files stay allocated on ZFS, so this only grows toward 100%.
Reclaimable: ZFS logical allocated − FS used; roughly what an fstrim would hand back to the pool.
Data = referenced bytes on disk (raidz parity/padding included, so it can exceed Size). Used also counts snapshots. FS used is blank for volumes not currently mounted (kubelet only reports mounted ones). Volumes with no PV are listed under Orphaned datasets.

panels.title: Orphaned datasets

targets.expr:
count(max by (name, pool, persistentvolume) (label_replace(zfs_dataset_used_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", type!="snapshot", name=~".*/pvc-[0-9a-f-]+"}, "persistentvolume", "$1", "name", ".*/(pvc-[0-9a-f-]+)$"))
  unless on (persistentvolume) kube_persistentvolume_info)

panels.description: pvc-* datasets on ZFS with no matching PersistentVolume in Kubernetes.

  unless on (persistentvolume) kube_persistentvolume_info)

panels.description: Space that destroying all orphaned datasets (and their snapshots) would free.

  unless on (persistentvolume) kube_persistentvolume_info

max by (name, pool, persistentvolume) (label_replace(zfs_dataset_volume_size_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", type!="snapshot", name=~".*/pvc-[0-9a-f-]+"}, "persistentvolume", "$1", "name", ".*/(pvc-[0-9a-f-]+)$"))
  unless on (persistentvolume) kube_persistentvolume_info

panels.description: Usually left behind when a PV with reclaimPolicy Retain is deleted, or when democratic-csi failed to clean up. Verify before destroying: the dataset name is the old PV name.

panels.title: Space held by snapshots
panels.description: Sum of each snapshot's unique space. Space shared by multiple snapshots is not counted.

panels.title: Oldest snapshot
panels.description: Sanoid keeps hourly=1, so every snapshot should be under ~1h old. Older ones mean pruning (autoprune) is failing.

panels.title: zvols without a snapshot

targets.expr: count(label_replace(max by (name) (zfs_dataset_volume_size_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool"}), "zvol", "$1", "name", "(.*)") unless on (zvol) max by (zvol) (label_replace(zfs_dataset_used_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", type="snapshot"}, "zvol", "$1", "name", "([^@]+)@.*"))) or vector(0)

panels.description: zvols that sanoid has not snapshotted (e.g. outside sas-pool/k8s/nvmeof/dataset).

panels.title: Largest snapshots

targets.expr: topk(25, max by (name, pool) (zfs_dataset_used_bytes{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", type="snapshot"}))
time() - max by (name, pool) (zfs_dataset_creation_timestamp{instance="$instance", pool=~"$pool", type="snapshot"})

panels.description: Unique space each snapshot holds — what destroying just that snapshot would free.
